author: Nia Warfield
title: Your first trade for Wednesday, January 13
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Alibaba .
Karen Finerman was a seller of Netflix .
Steve Grasso was a buyer of Lennar .
Guy Adami was a buyer of CBS .
